purpose: Evaluate whether a future descriptive USD Impact Score specification can reduce normalization revision dependence and correlated-driver concentration while preserving interpretability and robustness. This protocol does not authorize a production change.

construct.primary: contemporaneous descriptive U.S. dollar regime state

data_contract.missing_data_policy: Use the same source freshness, provenance, limited calendar-alignment forward fill, Friday resampling and complete-case requirements as v2 unless a separately versioned protocol amendment is registered before inspecting affected prospective outcomes.
data_contract.prospective_holdout_source: Use immutable as-published weekly input/reproduction artifacts from the production pipeline beginning 2026-08-28, rather than later revised provider history, wherever the required raw weekly level is present.
data_contract.historical_research_data_status: Current-vintage provider history available at protocol implementation; not an as-published historical vintage.
data_contract.historical_snapshot_requirement: Before the first v3 candidate time series is calculated, freeze and hash the retrospective weekly-level research matrix used to initialize candidate state. Do not replace that snapshot to improve results.

benchmark.description: Current production v2 full-sample weekly-level z-score with fixed equal-magnitude signed weights. Used only as the incumbent comparison benchmark.

candidates.description: Expanding point-in-time weekly-level normalization with the existing v2 signed weights.

normalization.history: all complete weeks strictly before t

candidates.description: Five-year-equivalent rolling point-in-time weekly-level normalization with existing v2 signed weights.

normalization.history: the 260 complete weeks strictly before t

candidates.description: Five-year-equivalent rolling point-in-time robust weekly-level normalization using median and scaled median absolute deviation, with existing v2 signed weights.

normalization.history: the 260 complete weeks strictly before t
normalization.zero_scale_policy: candidate week is invalid and must fail closed; do not substitute another scale after observing the result

candidates.description: Same prior-only robust 260-week normalization as V3_MAD260, with fixed ex-ante equal absolute weight by four interpretation groups rather than equal weight by eight drivers.

normalization.history: the 260 complete weeks strictly before t
normalization.zero_scale_policy: candidate week is invalid and must fail closed; do not substitute another scale after observing the result

required_diagnostics: ordinary contribution HHI and effective component count

prospective_primary_endpoints.definition: For every candidate week, appending later prospective weeks must not change that week's stored candidate score when recomputed from the same frozen as-of inputs and prior history.
Median of the predeclared absolute-correlation-adjusted contribution effective count over the prospective holdout, calculated with a 52-week prior component-correlation window when available.
Minimum regime-label agreement over the eight predeclared leave-one-driver-out variants during the prospective holdout.
Share of consecutive prospective weeks whose regime label differs from the previous prospective week.
Median prospective share of gross absolute score contribution attributable to the largest single driver each week.

eligibility_gates: Candidate has no future observations in week-t normalization.
Candidate score for an already-recorded prospective week is invariant when later weeks are appended.
Candidate produces finite scores for every prospective week with sufficient declared history, except an explicitly fail-closed zero-scale event.
Candidate uses exactly the preregistered formula, weights, clipping and thresholds; no post-hoc tuning is permitted.
Candidate's prospective regime-turnover rate is no more than 1.25 times the v2 benchmark turnover rate over the same prospective weeks.
Candidate's minimum leave-one-driver-out regime agreement is no more than 5 percentage points below the v2 benchmark over the same prospective weeks.
No candidate may be promoted on the basis of retrospective anchor-window hit rates or a trading/PnL metric.

selection_rule_after_52_weeks.step_1: Exclude every candidate that fails any eligibility gate.
selection_rule_after_52_weeks.step_2: Among eligible candidates, prefer the highest median prospective effective correlated component count only if it is at least 10% higher than the v2 benchmark over the same prospective weeks.
selection_rule_after_52_weeks.step_3: If the top candidates are within 5% of one another on that endpoint, prefer the higher minimum leave-one-driver-out regime agreement.
selection_rule_after_52_weeks.step_4: If still tied within 2 percentage points, prefer the lower prospective regime-turnover rate.
selection_rule_after_52_weeks.step_5: If still tied, prefer the simpler specification in this fixed order: V3_E52, V3_R260, V3_MAD260, V3_GRP_MAD260.
selection_rule_after_52_weeks.no_eligible_candidate_result: Keep v2 in production and report that the preregistered v3 study did not justify promotion.

reporting_schedule.prospective_weekly_storage: Store candidate values from each completed Friday after 2026-08-28 in a research-only immutable artifact once implementation is approved.
reporting_schedule.interim_review_rule: Interim reports may identify data-quality or implementation defects but may not alter formulas, select a winner or recommend production promotion. A genuine implementation defect requires a protocol amendment with a new version and a reset prospective holdout for affected candidates.

promotion_requirements: At least 52 completed prospective weeks under the locked protocol.
All eligibility gates pass for the selected candidate.
Selection follows the preregistered rule without a post-hoc metric change.
A separate production Score v3 methodology document and machine-readable contract are reviewed publicly.
A separate production PR changes the model version; v2 is not silently overwritten.
A parallel shadow period is completed before replacing the public v2 score.
Compliance language continues to describe the score as descriptive unless a separate predictive protocol is completed.
excluded_work: No 2008 canonical v2 or v3 result under this protocol.
No predictive target, forecast horizon, loss function, strategy return or PnL optimization.
No candidate added because it looks better after 2026-08-28 data are observed.
separate_predictive_study_requirement: Any future predictive claim requires a different preregistered protocol defining the target, forecast horizon, loss/score metric, training data, validation data and untouched test period before results are inspected.
